payload.title: Optional base investigation

sections.heading: Non-gating extension
sections.text: Imagine a counting system in which each place to the left is worth five times its neighbour. Invent notation for six objects and eleven objects, and explain your rules. Compare the grouping with our decimal system. This is a proposed LiberiaLearn extension, optional, and never required for core progression.
